scorecard.method: Observable structural signals. 0-100 per dimension. Weighted average with coding_weight=2x

dimensions.name: Coding Depth
dimensions.evidence: Claude Code: SWE-bench 80.8%, specialized Read/Edit/Grep tools, 200K context. Hermes: basic file_tools, no code-aware tools

dimensions.name: Codebase Reasoning
dimensions.evidence: Claude Code: extended thinking, sub-agent delegation, Glob/Grep specialized. Hermes: terminal grep only

dimensions.name: IDE Integration
dimensions.evidence: Claude Code: VS Code + JetBrains + remote dev. Hermes: terminal only

dimensions.name: Git/GitHub Workflow
dimensions.evidence: Claude Code: native gh CLI, PR creation, GitHub Actions, auto-fix. Hermes: shell git only

dimensions.name: Permission & Security
dimensions.evidence: Claude Code: 5 permission modes, sandboxing, fine-grained rules. Hermes: approval flows, Tirith security, skills_guard

dimensions.name: Multi-Platform Access
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: 15 platform adapters. Claude Code: CLI + IDE + Web + Desktop

dimensions.name: Self-Learning
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: autonomous SKILL.md creation, skills_guard, Skills Hub marketplace. Claude Code: manual skills, auto-memory (declarative only)

dimensions.name: Session Recall
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: SQLite FTS5, cross-session search, Gemini summarization. Claude Code: /resume list, file-based memory

dimensions.name: Multi-Model Reasoning
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: MoA with 4 frontier models. Claude Code: Agent Teams (same model family)

dimensions.name: Voice & Multimodal
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: 5 TTS + STT + voice mode + image gen. Claude Code: dictation input + native vision

dimensions.name: Remote Execution
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: 7 environments (Docker/SSH/Modal/Daytona/Singularity). Claude Code: local + cloud only

dimensions.name: Extensibility & Plugins
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: plugin system, skills marketplace, toolset distributions. Claude Code: MCP + hooks + skills (manual)

dimensions.name: Cost Efficiency
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: $5/mo VPS + any API. Claude Code: $20-200/mo subscription + API

dimensions.name: Deployment Flexibility
dimensions.evidence: Hermes: VPS, GPU cluster, serverless, Nix, Docker, Homebrew. Claude Code: npm install, Anthropic cloud

dimensions.name: Documentation & Community
dimensions.evidence: Claude Code: comprehensive official docs, enterprise support. Hermes: good docs site, 22k stars, 242 contributors

weighted_totals.notes: Hermes leads on breadth (platforms, learning, flexibility). Claude Code leads on depth (coding, IDE, Git). With coding_weight=2x, near parity.

coding_focused_totals.notes: On coding-only dimensions (Coding Depth, Codebase Reasoning, IDE, Git, SWE-bench), Claude Code dominates

autonomy_focused_totals.notes: On autonomy dimensions (Self-Learning, Session Recall, Multi-Model, Remote Exec, Multi-Platform), Hermes dominates
